marta: taking primary for the next 6h — i'm primary 09:00-15:00 PT. quick context: we saw p99 latency blips on text-gen yesterday (likely kv-cache thrash). i'm on phone and slack. page @marta for pages; @ari is secondary. leaving a short handoff checklist below. :wave:

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: HIGH latency on /api/v1/generate — incident INC-3492 — triggered at 2026-03-15T09:12:14Z — severity: P1 — PagerDuty link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-3492

ari: i'm here — will take customer followups if needed. quick checks:
- check grafana -> infra/kv-cache -> "kv-hit-rate" panel
- check model-serving pods for OOMs (`kubectl get pods -n prod | grep model-serve`)

kevin: FYI, if kv-hit-rate < 65% we usually see prefix-cache evictions. tried the cache-compaction yesterday; it reduced p99 by ~20%. run:```sh /opt/tools/compact_kv.sh prod```
only run during low traffic or with traffic-ctrl.

sam: if this escalates into customer visible errors (5xx or API timeouts), create RED ticket and tag @cs-urgent + include sample request ids. quick note: use the customer-impact template: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue!default.jspa?template=customer-impact

marta: runbook anchors i recommend for this shift: 
- KV cache troubleshooting: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/kv-cache-troubleshoot (steps A1-A5)
- Rolling restart guidance: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/rollouts/rolling-restart-prod
- Fallback to quantized-model (if GPU mem pressure): https://runbooks.redwood.internal/models/fallback-quantized

lex: small ops tip — when restarting inference-deploy, first scale replicas down to 0.5x then back up to avoid thundering herd. example:```kubectl scale deploy/inference-deploy --replicas=5 -n prod
sleep 30
kubectl scale deploy/inference-deploy --replicas=10 -n prod```

marta: handoff checklist (copy/paste):
- primary oncall: marta (09:00-15:00 PT)
- secondary: ari (coverage for customer contacts)
- pager policy: page primary for P1/P0 latency or errors; page secondary for CS escalations only
- runbooks: kv-cache-troubleshoot, rolling-restart-prod, fallback-quantized (links above)
- quick diagnostics: grafana kv-hit-rate, k8s pod status, nodelog (tail last 200 lines)```bash
kubectl logs -n prod -l app=inference --tail=200 | tail -n 200
```
- mitigation quicks: compact_kv, controlled rolling restart, model-fallback (use only when quantized variant validated)
- communication: update incident channel + create RED ticket if customer seen impact

ari: ack. i'll pair on any pagers. if you need me to take the bridge ping me and i'll join.

marta: thanks — i'll post a quick summary at shift end and tag next primary. ping here for any questions. :thumbsup:
